notes.title: 10 Months of Development in 10 Minutes
notes.content: [h2]Hello everyone![/h2][p][/p][p]If you want to get a quick update on [b]Roguebound Pirates[/b] + get a peek behind the scenes, I just published a brief video going through all the major things I have added to the game during the last 10 months. I hope you enjoy it![/p][p][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://youtu.be/ruJenvCVyL4"][/dynamiclink][/p][p]Let me know if you have any comments, feedback or suggestions![/p]
